reply.rationale: No defensible paradigm is supported. Every supplied code is a unique two-character symbol, and there are no minimal pairs showing one slot held constant while another alternates with a stable semantic contrast. Shared initial or final characters (e.g. C in CD/CT/CV or E in ES/FE/DE) do not by themselves justify segmentation, because the meanings do not decompose into recurring, role-stable contributions in a common frame. Digits are absent, and there are no standalone key entries declaring class members. Since any proposed split would invent morpheme boundaries without paradigm evidence, the safest analysis is a flat lexicon.
